sources.title: F1 Starting light sound
sources.author: Daniel2134
sources.changes: First isolated cue, normalized and synchronized to each red lamp.

soundDesign.controls: M / Sound toggle, volume on ready screen
soundDesign.gearControl: Observed Monza speed/RPM relationships; gear-dependent minimum holds, speed-linked shift points, short upshift transient. Only real braking allows downshifts. Cruise, reveal and freeze do not shift.
soundDesign.rpmVariation: Independent stable car parameters, subtle per-combustion amplitude/timing variation; no sustained electric layer.
soundDesign.doppler: Relative source/listener radial motion, smoothed, bounded.
soundDesign.backgroundMix: Focused car leads; distant individual voices stay quieter.
soundDesign.reference: OpenF1 2025 Monza qualifying, session 9908, driver 1, lap 17. Approx 3.7 Hz data; timing inspiration only, not exact team telemetry reconstruction.
soundDesign.downshift: Braking-only rapid sequential downshifts; 75–87 ms minimum dwell, short audible rev-match load/gain accent with fast transient response. Road-RPM safety gate retained.
soundDesign.slowMotionHandoff: Hold the last engine RPM/load and Doppler pitch; fade level by scene handoff time. Visual slowdown is not engine braking, and zero visual speed does not abruptly mute an existing fading voice.

synthesis.render: AudioWorklet, embedded data module for file origins; inline DSP compatibility if unavailable
synthesis.acoustics: Six mildly varying blowdown pulses, frequency-damped pipes, two-stage outlet lowpass and combustion-gated flow noise.
